method: Fresh readback of saved replicate and summary files. Scalar Python sums independently checked six estimators in the first replicate of every scenario; all 192 summary rows independently recomputed from saved replicates. Original 100-mask CC and Hajek values were separately regenerated and checked during derivation. No original runner or verifier was imported or executed.
limitations: Separate arithmetic checks validate these saved diagnostic derivations, not all original nuisance fits or the scientific adequacy of the original gate. Near-nominal normal-interval coverage is conditional on fixed loss and nuisance vectors and known design probabilities.
